subject.title: [Bug]: --to flag ignored when using --agent with custom channel, all sessions map to main

question: Should the active fix for explicit `--agent --channel --to` routing use raw recipient-derived session keys, or require a bounded/opaque key contract and upgrade handling before merge?
rationale: The bug is valid, but the fix changes persisted session identity and can expose recipient identifiers, which requires maintainer intent rather than another independent issue-fix PR.

options.title: Refresh With Bounded/Opaque Keys
options.body: Refresh or replace the open PR on current main, preserve explicit `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or maintainer-approved opaque recipient key contract.

options.title: Accept Raw Recipient Keys
options.body: Land raw channel/recipient-derived keys only after the PR body and tests make that persisted identifier contract explicit and accepted.

options.title: Pause The Fix Candidate
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose a different compatibility or privacy design before implementation continues.

recommendation.title: Refresh With Bounded/Opaque Keys
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the open PR on current main, preserve explicit `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence, and use a bounded or maintainer-approved opaque recipient key contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the active closing PR and has recent merged history in the same resolver boundary.
